entities.summary: Italian maritime republic and trading hub built on 118 islands in a lagoon, dominating Mediterranean commerce from the 9th to 16th centuries. Venice's unique geography, merchant oligarchy, naval power, and position as gateway between Europe and the East made it one of the wealthiest and most influential cities in history.
